project: Self-Learning AI Company — continuous Seedance chain
anchor_contract: K(i) is the final frame supplied to scene i and the initial frame supplied to scene i+1. Once a take is accepted, extract its actual final frame and replace the planned K(i) for the next scene.
style_contract: Warm editorial comic explainer: cream paper, sage contour border, cocoa hand-drawn linework, cyan intelligence/data, amber value, coral exceptions, white character figures. No generated words, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks.

anchors.visual: A nearly empty cream drafting board in the same isometric AI-operations workshop, a single inactive brown machine at right, faint cyan blueprint lines waiting to be drawn.

anchors.source: Slide 01 — Architecting AI for measurable ROI
anchors.visual: The inactive machine has assembled into one compact closed-loop AI engine: observe, decide, act and measure are shown by four unlabeled icon stations connected in a cyan loop; a calm operator observes it.

anchors.source: Slide 02 — Financial crisis of unmeasurable AI
anchors.visual: The same engine has fragmented into brittle disconnected automation pipes, leaking coral exceptions and spilling amber coins; one finance operator holds an opaque report beside a tilted blank gauge.

The broken system resolves into a controlled comparison lab: two parallel transaction channels, one cyan AI-assisted and one brown baseline, pass matching packages toward two transparent measurement scales.

The parallel lab becomes a direct visual contrast: a rigid brown runbook conveyor jams on one side while a cyan adaptive loop routes identical work around the obstacle and returns a measurement signal.
The adaptive loop tightens into a clear circular feedback engine. Three unlabeled signal sources feed the left side; cleaned cyan signals return from the right as the engine visibly improves itself.
The circular engine unfolds into three connected specialist workstations around a central routing hub. A single coral exception takes a distinct gentle path to a human desk.
The specialist stations break apart into clean snap-together modules traveling on a cyan conveyor. White workers recombine the same modules into two useful workflows.

The modular conveyor approaches three sequential preparation gates: total-cost tokens, a baseline ruler and stopwatch, and a financial-model balance. The AI engine waits beyond the gates, not yet active.
The gates open and the engine runs. Cyan telemetry flows toward a calendar, a stopwatch, an error gauge and a baseline-versus-actual chart, with two review checkpoints.

anchors.source: Slide 10 — Native observability and real-time tracing
anchors.visual: The telemetry board grows into a transparent control room: every tool handoff is visible as a node-and-pipe trace, with throughput, latency, queue and failure icons feeding a revision loop.
The control room fans its exact same signals into three aligned transparent viewing windows: value outcome, user task flow and technical trace. Three stakeholders view their respective window.

The three windows fold into an auditable finance desk where reconciliation tiles travel through the loop, clean items route forward and one discrepancy is caught. A rising unlabeled value curve is visible.
The finance desk transforms into an IT control funnel. A storm of alert tokens enters, most leave as calm mint resolved items, and one coral exception reaches a human operator.
The IT funnel becomes a compact factory: raw parts enter a smart machine, recovered material loops back, and an efficient shipment exits. Three unlabeled efficiency gauges stabilize.
The factory expands into an autonomous enterprise landscape: finance, IT and manufacturing units are visibly connected by one cyan learning loop around a calm central operations core at sunrise.

scenes.beat: Blueprint lines wake up and assemble the first measurable closed loop.
scenes.timing: 0–2s blueprint appears; 2–5s stations assemble and connect; 5–6s loop pulses once.

scenes.beat: The promise of the engine breaks when measurement disappears: loop fragments, leaks and stranded value appear.
scenes.camera: Slow orbit right, hold on the leak.
scenes.timing: 0–2s loop runs; 2–4s pipes disconnect; 4–6s coral leak and opaque report reveal.

scenes.beat: The opaque report splits open into two comparable operational cohorts.
scenes.timing: 0–2s report opens; 2–4s twin channels form; 4–6s scales settle together.

scenes.beat: The controlled comparison demonstrates why a static runbook jams while a loop adapts.
scenes.camera: Wide locked isometric view with a subtle push-in.
scenes.timing: 0–2s both channels move; 2–3s brown conveyor jams; 3–5s cyan route bends around it; 5–6s measurement return flashes.

scenes.beat: The adaptive route contracts into a single self-improving feedback engine.
scenes.camera: Top-down crane down into the ring.
scenes.timing: 0–2s route curves inward; 2–4s source signals enter; 4–6s refined output returns and ring brightens.

scenes.beat: One loop delegates work to three specialists and escalates only the exception.
scenes.camera: Gentle clockwise arc around the hub.
scenes.timing: 0–2s ring opens; 2–4s three stations rise; 4–6s packets route, exception peels toward human.

scenes.beat: Specialist stations atomize into reusable blocks, then reassemble into workflows.
scenes.camera: Side tracking shot along the conveyor.
scenes.timing: 0–2s stations unlock; 2–3s modules separate; 3–5s modules glide; 5–6s two workflow shapes click together.

scenes.beat: Reusable blocks must pass cost, baseline and financial-model gates before activation.
scenes.timing: 0–2s first gate rises; 2–4s second and third gate appear; 4–6s modules stop before the inactive engine.

scenes.beat: The gates open, the operation launches, and telemetry replaces assumptions with observed outcomes.
scenes.camera: Push through the final gate, then pan to the telemetry board.
scenes.timing: 0–2s gates open; 2–4s engine activates; 4–6s cyan data fills charts and review checkpoints.

scenes.beat: Operational metrics expand into full observability: each decision and handoff becomes traceable.
scenes.camera: Crane up and slight pull-back to reveal the full trace network.
scenes.timing: 0–2s telemetry streams; 2–4s nodes and traces emerge; 4–6s a failed path loops into revision.

scenes.beat: One trace network reframes itself into executive, product and technical lenses.
scenes.timing: 0–2s traces align; 2–4s three windows unfold; 4–6s three stakeholders step into view.

scenes.beat: The stakeholder lenses collapse into auditable finance operations and visible return.
scenes.camera: Truck right from windows to finance desk.
scenes.timing: 0–2s windows fold; 2–4s reconciliation desk forms; 4–6s clean flow, caught discrepancy and value curve resolve.

scenes.beat: The finance loop becomes an IT control room where a storm of events is quietly filtered.
scenes.camera: Fast but smooth vertical crane from desk to funnel, then hold.
scenes.timing: 0–2s papers transform into tokens; 2–4s tokens enter funnel; 4–6s resolved stream exits, one exception reaches human.

scenes.beat: Filtered operational flow turns into a factory that recovers materials while adapting production.
scenes.camera: Follow the cyan path into the factory, modest push-in.
scenes.timing: 0–2s funnel pipe extends; 2–4s machines assemble; 4–6s recovery loop closes and shipment departs.

scenes.beat: The factory pulls back into an enterprise where finance, IT and manufacturing learn from one system.
scenes.camera: Crane up to a wide final tableau.
scenes.timing: 0–2s factory stabilizes; 2–4s surrounding enterprise units rise; 4–6s one cyan loop connects all systems and settles.
